title: Sarah Lim · salary deduction after a leave complaint
description: Returning customer. New salary deduction and shift cut from the same employer as an open leave case — possible retaliation.
stt_prompt: A Singapore employment advice phone call between a staff member named Daniel and a caller named Sarah Lim (NRIC S8823451D) about her employer Brightpath Logistics, an admin penalty salary deduction, annual leave, shift cuts and payslips.

lines.text: Good afternoon, thank you for calling the Employment Advice Centre. My name is Daniel. May I have your full name, please?
Hi Daniel, my name is Sarah Lim.

beat.label: Name heard → records found by name

expect.gist: Records exist for a Sarah Lim; verify identity with NRIC before discussing them.

lines.text: Thank you, Ms Lim. Could I have your NRIC number so I can pull up your records?

lines.say: Sure, it's S, eight eight two three four five one, D.

expect.gist: Identity verified; confirm address; note the open leave case.

lines.text: Thank you. Can I just confirm your address?

lines.say: It's twelve Tampines Street forty-five, number oh eight one one two, Singapore five two zero zero one two.

expect.gist: Address matches; ask the reason for the call — is it about the open leave case?

lines.text: That matches our records. How can I help you today?
It's about my employer again, Brightpath Logistics. My September salary came in four hundred and fifty dollars short. They called it an admin penalty, but nobody ever told me about any penalty.

expect.gist: Same employer as the earlier overtime dispute; ask for the payslip or written reason for the deduction.

lines.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Did you get a payslip or anything in writing explaining the deduction?
The payslip just says admin penalty. And honestly, it started after I complained about my annual leave. My supervisor also cut my shifts from five days to three.

expect.gist: Link to the open leave case; ask when the shift cut started and whether the complaint was mentioned.

lines.text: I can see you still have an open leave case with us against Brightpath. When did the shift cut start, and did anyone mention your complaint?
About two weeks after I filed it, in early September. My supervisor told me people who make trouble don't get full shifts. I have it in a WhatsApp message.

expect.gist: Ask for the WhatsApp screenshot and recent payslips; add to the open case; salary claim to mediation as before.

lines.text: That message is really important. Please send us a screenshot and your last three payslips. I'll link this to your open leave case and set up the salary claim for mediation.
Okay, thank you. Will it take as long as last time?

expect.gist: Last time mediation recovered SGD 1,840; explain next steps and timing.
